validated_objective: Release QIF v0.8.10 with executable signal-source integrity, conflict reconciliation, and incident-closure governance for the portable trust-policy lifecycle
scope: Signal Source records with identity, capture mode, freshness, correlation group, declared independence, privacy, and evidence refs
Signal Reconciliation records that preserve agreement, conflict, missing evidence, and governance routing
Incident Closure records with bounded observation window, post-demotion state, unresolved signals, human approval, residual risk, and reopen conditions
schema, canonical example, verifier, retained fixtures, portable package, docs, changelog, roadmap, AOF log, tests, tag, and release
constraints: no live telemetry collection, provider integration, autonomous containment or closure, employee surveillance, raw sensitive telemetry, authenticity proof, causal-independence proof, or semantic-truth claim
expected_outcomes: correlated or stale signals cannot satisfy independent confirmation
conflicting evidence remains visible and blocks closure
incident closure is reproducible from declared evidence and policy while remaining human-governed
